title: The Grateful Dead Live at Seattle Center Arena on 1973-06-26
lineage: MAC(Sony TC-126)>R@7.5 ips.(Don's edited copy)>R@3.3/4 ips(Matt Williams reel)>FLAC

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy 1973 performance highlighted by a blazing Truckin’ → The Other One and a vivid Here Comes Sunshine; the audience tape is warm but a bit muddy with limited bass.
ai_review.review: The show bursts with excitement – the band is practically off the rails, delivering tight jams in the first set and an especially wild second set where Truckin' and The Other One shine.  The recording, sourced from an audience tape, captures that vibe but suffers from a thin low end, harsh upper mids and a mildly muddy character, making it best enjoyed at moderate volume.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers consistently praise the musical performance (standout jams, high energy) and give high star ratings; recording quality is noted as decent but imperfect, leading to an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm overall but lacking bass, upper‑mid harshness and a slightly muddy texture; not ideal for high volume listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set tight and playful, second set even crazier with sustained high energy; the band seems to be having a blast throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is thin on this tape but Phil's higher‑frequency tones come through clearly.
